payload.body: Durable learning: when producer metadata names external consumers PARTIAL_ALIVE, do not add more producer sensors. Extract one producer-owned VERIFY_ONLY consumer court plus contract schema, then execute that court inside each target repository authority domain. This preserves producer != consumer evidence while eliminating verifier duplication. Observed result: reusable marketplace primitive merged; ggen and chatgpt-cloud-elixir independently exact-head qualified and merged. Falsifier: producer-only execution never upgrades an external consumer to ALIVE.
payload.title: R48 reusable independent-consumer court learning
